title: Service Mesh (Istio, Cilium Mesh, mTLS & Traffic Control)
summary: Master Istio and Cilium Service Mesh architectures: strict mutual TLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE identities), L7 VirtualService traffic splitting, DestinationRules, and circuit breaking.
learningObjectives: Configure Istio VirtualService and DestinationRule resources for weighted canary traffic management.
Enforce cluster-wide or namespace-scoped STRICT mutual TLS via PeerAuthentication.
Audit Envoy proxy synchronization and mesh configuration using istioctl.

curriculumModules.title: Istio Control Plane (istiod), Sidecar & Ambient Dataplanes
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: istiod compiles Kubernetes and Istio routing rules into Envoy xDS configuration, issuing short-lived X.509 SPIFFE certificates (`spiffe://cluster.local/ns/<ns>/sa/<sa>`) for automatic mTLS.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Enforce `PeerAuthentication` with `mtls.mode: STRICT` in production namespaces so all east-west microservice traffic is mutually authenticated and encrypted.

curriculumModules.title: L7 Traffic Splitting, Retries & Circuit Breaking
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: `VirtualService` defines how requests route to a service (headers, weights, timeouts, retries), while `DestinationRule` defines subsets (`v1`, `v2`), load-balancing algorithms, and outlier detection circuit breakers.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Combine DestinationRule outlier detection with VirtualService weighted routing (`90% v1 / 10% v2`) for zero-downtime canary testing.

labs.title: Configuring Istio VirtualService & DestinationRule for Canary Routing
labs.scenario: Configure Istio traffic management for the `reviews` microservice in `production` by creating a `VirtualService` (`reviews-route`) and `DestinationRule` (`reviews-destination`).
labs.productionContext: Service meshes decouple deployment scaling from traffic routing, allowing 10% canary traffic even with a small pod count.
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: reviews-route
  namespace: production
---
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
  name: reviews-destination
  namespace: production

validationRules.description: Validated mesh configuration with istioctl analyze

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Confirm both `reviews-route` and `reviews-destination` exist in `production` (`kubectl get vs,dr -n production`).

labs.title: Enforcing Strict mTLS with Istio PeerAuthentication
labs.scenario: Enforce strict mutual TLS across all workloads in `production` by creating a `PeerAuthentication` policy named `default-strict-mtls` with `spec.mtls.mode` set to `STRICT`.
labs.productionContext: Strict mTLS prevents plaintext lateral movement and guarantees cryptographic workload identity verification.
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: PeerAuthentication
metadata:
  name: default-strict-mtls
  namespace: production
spec:
  mtls:
    mode: STRICT

validationRules.description: PeerAuthentication mode is set to STRICT
validationRules.name: default-strict-mtls

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Check `kubectl get peerauthentication default-strict-mtls -n production -o json` to verify `spec.mtls.mode` is `STRICT`.

assessmentQuestions.question: Which standard identity format does Istio use to encode workload identities inside X.509 mTLS certificates?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Istio issues X.509 certificates containing a Subject Alternative Name (SAN) formatted according to the CNCF SPIFFE specification.

assessmentQuestions.question: In Istio, which resource defines traffic subsets (`v1`, `v2`), connection pool settings, and outlier detection circuit breakers?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: A `DestinationRule` configures policies applied to traffic *after* VirtualService routing has occurred, including named subsets, TLS settings, and circuit breakers.
